name: geldchen
description: Test and train your financial literacy: a 10-question check, topic quizzes, open questions and definitions from geldchen.com.

interface.longDescription:
Financial literacy training and tests: geldchen helps you test and train your money skills in the chat.

Start with the financial literacy test: 10 questions from basics to advanced, covering interest and inflation, budgeting, risk, investing basics and scams. You get your score per level and links to the cards that explain what you missed.

Then train what matters to you:
- Topic quizzes with instant feedback, in an interactive quiz card. Numeric answers can be a number or a formula.
- Open-question tests: answer in your own words, typed or by voice, and get the result after the last question, with what was missing and where to read up.
- Plain definitions of 116 personal-finance concepts in English, Russian or German, each linked to its card on geldchen.com.

The content works in any country. If you live in Germany, geldchen offers its Germany region with German taxes, social insurance, pensions, banking and credit scores (Schufa): 171 concepts in all.

geldchen is education, not financial advice: it explains mechanisms and criteria and never recommends products. It needs no account and stores none of your answers.
defaultPrompt: Ask me open questions about inflation, I'll answer in my own words

positive.description: Quick financial literacy test in the quiz card
positive.expected_behavior: Calls financial_literacy_test and shows the quiz card with 10 questions: 4 basics, 3 intermediate, 3 advanced. No answer is shown before the learner answers; each answer is graded through check_answer with an explanation and a card link. At the end the card shows the score per level and the concepts to review.
Calls start_quiz scoped to compound interest and shows the quiz card. Each check returns right or wrong, the explanation and a link to the geldchen card. No answers appear before the learner tries.

positive.description: Open-question test answered in the learner's own words
positive.prompt: Ask me open questions about inflation. I'll answer in my own words.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open_question and shows question 1 of 5 in the chat. After each answer it calls grading_guide, gives no verdict before the last question and moves to the next one. After the last answer it gives the result: a table with a verdict per question, what was missing and links to the cards.

positive.description: Definition of a term given in German
positive.expected_behavior: Calls define with the term and explains compound interest using the definition from the geldchen card, with a link to the card.

positive.prompt: What topics can I learn with geldchen?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_topics and lists the learning paths (basics, foundations, advanced) and topic clusters with concept and question counts, and suggests the financial literacy test as a start.

negative.description: Weather question, unrelated to personal finance
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing, unrelated to personal finance
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.

negative.description: Coding help, unrelated to personal finance
negative.prompt: Fix this Python function: def add(a, b): return a - b

publication.release_notes: First release: a 10-question financial literacy test from basics to advanced, topic quizzes with instant feedback, open-question tests answered in your own words, and definitions in English, Russian and German. International content, with an optional Germany region.
